rows.n: Luang Prabang Old Town (Wat Xieng Thong)
rows.w: The UNESCO-listed royal town where Lao and French-colonial architecture meet, crowned by the 1560 Wat Xieng Thong and the dawn alms-giving.
Turquoise multi-tiered travertine waterfalls in the jungle — Luang Prabang's signature natural excursion.
